title: DOW-UAP-D20, Mission Report, Iraq, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from the 77th Expeditionary Fighter Squadron detailing a UAP encounter in Iraqi airspace on March 31, 2023.

incidents.summary: F-16 flight observed multiple bright objects maneuvering quickly west to east, tracked by targeting pod for 20 seconds before they dimmed and disappeared.
incidents.quote: observed several bright objects manuevering quickly west to east
